author: Scott Gustafson
video_title: 🤪 The Boy Who Cried Wolf 🐺 Aesop's Fables Short Read Aloud for Kids
description:
A little boy learns that one's credibility isn't worth giving away for a few laughs.

Mr. Paul reads aloud "The Boy Who Cried Wolf," an Aesop's Fable, retold and illustrated by Scott Gustafson. This short, colorful fable is perfect either as a bedtime story at home, or for story time at school. With its vivid illustrations and unforgettable narrative, this compact moral lesson is excellent for students in kindergarten, first grade, second grade, and even third grade. Aesop's Fables offer a fun way to deliver pearls of wisdom that will last a lifetime.

author: Aesop, Scott Gustafson
video_title: 🐹 The Country Mouse and the City Mouse 🐭 Aesop's Fable Short Read Aloud for Kids
description:
Two childhood friends are reunited, and each samples life in the other one's world!

Mr. Paul reads aloud "The Country Mouse and the City Mouse," an Aesop's Fable illustrated by Scott Gustafson. This short fable is an excellent way to demonstrate how people get accustomed to their own life patterns, and how seeing things from a different perspective can be challenging. The lush illustrations add whimsy to this classic tale, which is well-suited to students in kindergarten, first grade, second grade, and third grade. The story works equally well as a family bedtime story at home, or for story time at school. It is also known as "City Mouse, Country Mouse."
